pr_title: tests/kernel/gen_isr_table: Add special configuration for nRF9160 and nRF5340
pr_body:
On nRF9160 and application core in nRF5340, not all interrupts with highest numbers are implemented, so the test cannot just use the last 6 ones. This patch adds a Kconfig option that can be used to limit the number of interrupts reported to the test and uses this option for nRF9160 and nRF5340 SoCs.
The existing workaround that limits the number of interrupts for ARC EMSDP is also changed to use this Kconfig option.

Fixes #26302.

review_comments: This is not a no-op, @anangl , TABLE_SIZE is now different from what it was before. Are you sure this is not breaking ARC? Or is it actually a fix? If so it should be reflected in the commit msg

Hm, OK, I see that IRQ_TABLE_SIZE is defined as 
`#define IRQ_TABLE_SIZE (CONFIG_NUM_IRQS - CONFIG_GEN_IRQ_START_VECTOR)` so it might have been picking the overwrite of CONFIG_NUM_IRQS in the earlier solution (@anangl confirm?)

Previously, `CONFIG_NUM_IRQS` was redefined. And this redefinition influenced the value of `IRQ_TABLE_SIZE`, because this macro references `CONFIG_NUM_IRQS` in its [definition](https://github.com/zephyrproject-rtos/zephyr/blob/a2d4292a96e0e3f710374b6da6d3d5060bccc905/include/sw_isr_table.h#L73). I wanted to get rid of this `#undef CONFIG_NUM_IRQS`, and that's why I needed to use `TEST_IRQ_TABLE_SIZE`, which differs from `IRQ_TABLE_SIZE` by the difference between `CONFIG_NUM_IRQS` and `TEST_NUM_IRQS`.

> Hm, OK, I see that IRQ_TABLE_SIZE is defined as
> `#define IRQ_TABLE_SIZE (CONFIG_NUM_IRQS - CONFIG_GEN_IRQ_START_VECTOR)` so it might have been picking the overwrite of CONFIG_NUM_IRQS in the earlier solution (@anangl confirm?)

I see that I was writing my comment in parallel with you adding yours. Yes, I confirm.
